supported_grammar.selection: The grammar of the executing Python runtime, passed explicitly to ast.parse as feature_version.
supported_grammar.freshness_binding: All three runtime fields participate in freshness_key_sha256.

detection.language_context: Explicit Python source selection or .py tree discovery.
detection.ambiguity: Files without a .py suffix and Python-compatible embedded languages are not guessed.

supported_subset: module, class, function, async-function, method, and async-method AST ownership
decorator spelling recovered with ast.unparse and source_span extended across decorator syntax
module, class, function, and method docstrings
leading-trivia and nearest-enclosing-symbol comment attachment, including decorator-region comments and trailing suite comments before lexical dedent
shebang, encoding-cookie, RATIOS, and MSDMD-fence module conventions
UTF-8 projection spans over decoded source split only at Python newlines (LF, CRLF, CR), including CR-only sources, and raw-source SHA-256
projection files written as exact UTF-8 bytes with LF record terminators on every platform

parse, tokenization, and malformed MSDMD-fence diagnostics: interrupted, unclosed, name-mismatched or nested-opening (msdmd_fence_mismatched), and unmatched-close (msdmd_fence_unmatched_close) fences, where a mismatch yields one diagnostic because one later close per affected block name, orphaned by that reported mismatch, is suppressed until the next opening of that name (an interrupted fence may also report its later close as msdmd_fence_unmatched_close); stricter than the universal block parser, which matches each block name independently
limitations: Sphinx, Google, and NumPy docstring field parsing
reconciliation with non-Python or MSDMD block collections
raw-file byte offsets: span byte offsets index the UTF-8 re-encoding of the decoded source text and differ from raw file offsets for BOM-prefixed or non-UTF-8 sources

attachment.leading_trivia: Attach a contiguous comment group to the immediately following declaration when lexical columns match.
attachment.nearest_enclosing_symbol: Attach every other interior comment to the deepest enclosing declaration, whose region begins at its first decorator and extends through trailing indented comments until lexical dedent.
attachment.module_convention: Keep shebangs, encoding cookies, RATIOS seals, and MSDMD fences at module scope.
attachment.module_scope: Keep otherwise unattached comments at module scope.

unknown_field_policy: Unsupported semantic parsing is not fabricated; the partial scope remains declared in this manifest and repository guidance.
failure_behavior: Invalid syntax, incomplete tokenization, or a malformed MSDMD fence (interrupted, unclosed, name-mismatched, nested opening, or unmatched close) emits a diagnostic and causes --check or --write to exit nonzero. Fence validation is stricter than the universal block parser.
